teaser: An outreach agent mapped eleven companies that control AI agents at Web Summit; most are partners for RiskMandate as much as competitors.
core_idea: On 5 November the Web Summit team's outreach agent and two research agents read the sites of eleven companies that control AI agents and built a public competitive page: each company in its own words with its source and an attendance label, a map, a before-during-after chain, where RiskMandate differs, where it is behind and what to do before 12 November. Most products act while or after an agent acts; RiskMandate acts before, on the gap between reach and mandate, so the others are barriers or evidence an Agent Behaviour Policy can name. The newsroom checked the page; corrections are small.

quotes.text: These products are the controls; RiskMandate is the record that says which controls an agent needs, and whether they are there.
That last one is a lesson the page already applies to itself.
